description: Register a file you created only for the demo (a seed script, a demo-data file, a scratch database). demo_finish deletes it so the repo is left as it was. Call it after demo_start. It must be inside the repo (made during this demo), the demo's scratch dir, or a temp dir you made (mktemp -d, even before demo_start): anything git tracks, the developer's uncommitted changes, and anything older are refused.
name: demo_temp_file
title: Register a temporary file
